items.q: Violaceous flat-topped polygonal papules with white lacy lines on wrists and intense itch suggest?
items.exp: Lichen planus shows pruritic purple polygonal papules with Wickham striae, favouring wrists, shins and oral mucosa.
r: Incorrect. That has faint scaly patches.
Correct. Purple polygonal papules with striae.
Incorrect. That has silvery extensor plaques.
Incorrect. That has tiny shiny papules.
items.kp: Purple itchy polygons mean lichen planus.

items.q: Reticulate white oral patches in a patient with violaceous wrist papules are?
items.exp: Oral lichen planus gives lacy reticular buccal plaques, sometimes erosive, alongside cutaneous disease.
r: Correct. Lacy buccal network with skin lesions.
Incorrect. That is a fixed white plaque.
Incorrect. That wipes off with curds.
Incorrect. Those are painful round ulcers.
items.kp: Lacy white mouth lines mean oral LP.

items.q: A herald patch followed by oval salmon lesions with collarette scale along cleavage lines is?
items.exp: Pityriasis rosea starts with a herald patch then Christmas-tree eruption with trailing collarette scale.
r: Incorrect. That involves palms and soles.
Incorrect. That follows sore throat without herald.
Incorrect. That has active advancing borders.
Correct. Herald patch then cleavage-line ovals.
items.kp: Herald patch with Christmas tree is pityriasis rosea.

items.q: Orange-red plaques with islands of sparing and palmoplantar thickening suggest?
items.exp: Pityriasis rubra pilaris is orange-red with skipped islands, follicular papules and waxy keratoderma.
r: Incorrect. That is greasy yellow in folds.
Incorrect. That gives patches evolving to tumours.
Correct. Orange-red with spared islands.
Incorrect. That is salmon-pink with silvery scale.
items.kp: Orange-red with spared islands is PRP.

o: It can evolve into cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
items.exp: Large-plaque parapsoriasis is a premalignant patch stage on the lymphoma spectrum needing surveillance and biopsy.
r: Incorrect. Follow-up is essential.
Correct. Lymphoma-spectrum surveillance is needed.
Incorrect. It persists for years.
Incorrect. It is not contagious.

items.q: Tiny shiny flat-topped skin-coloured papules on the penis and forearms with Koebner lines are?
items.exp: Lichen nitidus gives pinpoint glistening papules with a claw-like rete pattern histologically.
r: Correct. Pinpoint shiny papules.
Incorrect. Those are umbilicated domes.
Incorrect. Those are larger flat warts.
Incorrect. Those are yellow sebaceous dots.
items.kp: Pinpoint shiny papules mean lichen nitidus.

items.q: Saw-tooth rete ridges with Civatte bodies and a band-like lymphocytic infiltrate on biopsy indicate?
items.exp: Lichenoid interface dermatitis with saw-tooth rete and colloid bodies is classic lichen planus histology.
r: Incorrect. That has regular acanthosis with Munro abscesses.
Incorrect. That has vacuolar change with mucin.
Incorrect. That has spongiosis.
Correct. Interface pattern with Civatte bodies.
items.kp: Saw-tooth rete with Civatte bodies is LP.

items.q: A photo-distributed violaceous eruption after starting a thiazide diuretic is best termed?
items.exp: Lichenoid drug reactions mimic lichen planus with photo accentuation and linger after withdrawal.
r: Incorrect. That recurs at one fixed site.
Incorrect. That gives sterile pustules with fever.
Correct. Photo-distributed lichenoid pattern.
Incorrect. That is symmetric red macules.
items.kp: Photo lichenoid rash on thiazide is drug-induced.

items.q: Longitudinal nail ridging with thinning and pterygium formation occurs in nail lichen planus because?
o: Matrix scarring fuses the fold to the bed
items.exp: Nail matrix lichen planus scars the matrix, splitting ridges and winging the proximal fold forward as pterygium.
r: Incorrect. Trauma causes isolated onycholysis.
Correct. Matrix scarring creates pterygium.
Incorrect. Fungus gives debris, not pterygium.
Incorrect. Psoriasis pits without winging.
items.kp: Nail pterygium signals matrix LP scarring.

items.q: A papulosquamous eruption involving palms and soles with painless nodes should first exclude?
items.exp: Secondary syphilis is the great mimicker with palmoplantar papules; serology settles it before labelling psoriasis.
r: Correct. Palms-soles demand syphilis serology.
Incorrect. That spares palms and soles.
Incorrect. That rarely covers palms fully.
Incorrect. That burrows webs, not palms diffusely.
